name: storyframe
description: A deterministic narrative engine, creator platform, and ChatGPT plugin.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm run build:admin && npm run build:launch && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/world-schema packages/engine-core packages/projections packages/storyframe packages/ai-director packages/persistence packages/application packages/auth packages/story-debugger packages/test-fixtures
scripts.check: npm run check:packages && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p admin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p launch/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check:packages: tsc -p packages/world-schema/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/engine-core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/projections/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/storyframe/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ai-director/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/persistence/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/application/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/auth/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/story-debugger/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/test-fixtures/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.eval:director:live: npm run build:packages && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && node scripts/eval-director-live.mjs
scripts.check:submission: npm run build:packages && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && node scripts/validate-submission.mjs
